svg.title: #296 Battle Flow — pre-implementation visual proposal
svg.desc: Editable static proposal with true 320px and 390px-wide frames and four representative states. Not product UI, runtime capture, or QA. Values marked ? are unknown placeholders; round and time are sketch examples only.
svg.metadata: ©2026 Sung Changjo and contributors. Existing battle artwork and UI assets are reused; see ASSET-LICENSE.md. Proposal only; no new raster art.
